title: MasterSpawn
description:
Lobby spawn plugin.
Used for Smp,Kitpvp and lobby.

body:
# MasterSpawn

MasterSpawn is the ultimate spawn management plugin for Minecraft servers. Designed to be simple, fast, and highly configurable, it allows administrators to precisely control server and player spawn points.

✨ Main Features
Set and manage the main server spawn.
Quick teleport to spawn with dedicated commands.
Separate spawn management for multiple worlds.
Automatic spawn handling for new players.
Customizable teleport messages.
Permission-based access control.
Lightweight and performance-friendly.
🎯 Why Choose MasterSpawn?

MasterSpawn was developed to provide a reliable and professional spawn system suitable for both small private servers and large Minecraft networks. Its stability and ease of use help create a smooth experience for players from their very first join.
